cards.answer: K'Sante is a tank fighter whose damage and shielding benefit from armor, magic resistance and health. He chains crowd control into attacks, then uses All Out to trade defenses for damage and healing.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from his follow-up attacks and avoid fighting with terrain behind you.

citations.quote: Name: K'Sante. Official role tags: Tank, Fighter.
Physical Damage:70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 (+ 40% bonus armor) (+ 40% bonus magic resistance)
Shield Strength:70 / 112.5 / 155 / 197.5 / 240 (+ 13.5% bonus health)

facts.claim: K'Sante is a tank fighter whose damage and shielding benefit from armor, magic resistance and health.

citations.quote: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.
K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.
Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

facts.claim: He chains crowd control into attacks, then uses All Out to trade defenses for damage and healing.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his control pattern and offensive transformation guides positioning.

cards.answer: His abilities mark enemies; basic attacks consume the mark for bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health. During All Out, his attacks and abilities gain additional physical damage based on the target's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Create distance after his abilities hit to limit follow-up attacks.

citations.quote: K'Sante's abilities mark enemies hit for a short time. His basic attacks on-hit consume the mark to deal bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

facts.claim: His abilities mark enemies; basic attacks consume the mark for bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

citations.quote: All Out Bonus: K'Sante's basic attacks and abilities are empowered to deal additional bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health

facts.claim: During All Out, his attacks and abilities gain additional physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

cards.priority_reason: Explains why allowing attacks after ability hits strengthens his trades.

cards.answer: Ntofo Strikes deals physical damage in a line and slows enemies. Repeated hits prepare an empowered shockwave that pulls enemies toward him and stuns them. During All Out, its cooldown is shorter and it no longer slows.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep his strikes and keep extra space when his empowered shockwave is ready.

citations.quote: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.
Active: K'Sante slams his ntofo down in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and slows them

facts.claim: Ntofo Strikes deals physical damage in a line and slows enemies.

citations.quote: If this hits at least one enemy, K'Sante generates a stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next Ntofo Strikes cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Empowered Active: K'Sante fires a shockwave in the target direction that applies the same effects to enemies hit, but also pulls them towards him over 0.65 seconds and stuns them for 0.8 seconds.

facts.claim: Repeated hits prepare an empowered shockwave that pulls enemies toward him and stuns them.

citations.quote: All Out Bonus: Ntofo Strikes's cooldown is reduced, but it no longer slows enemies hit.

facts.claim: During All Out, its cooldown is shorter and it no longer slows.

cards.priority_reason: His repeatable control tool creates opportunities for displacement and follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: Path Maker charges with damage reduction and cannot be interrupted by crowd control, then dashes in its initially chosen direction, damaging, carrying and stunning enemies hit. During All Out, it gains stronger damage reduction, a faster dash and bonus true damage, but loses its knockback and stun; entering All Out refreshes its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the dash path during the charge and save burst until his damage reduction ends.

citations.quote: During this time, he gains displacement immunity and 25% damage reduction
Path Maker's charge cannot be interrupted by crowd control.

Recast: K'Sante dashes in the direction he targeted at the time of cast, though not through terrain, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through, carrying them alongside him, and stunning them

facts.claim: Path Maker charges with damage reduction and cannot be interrupted by crowd control, then dashes in its initially chosen direction, damaging, carrying and stunning enemies hit.

citations.quote: All Out Bonus: Path Maker no longer applies its knock back and stun, but its damage reduction is increased to 70%, the dash deals 10% – 80% (based on channel time) bonus true damage, and the dash speed is increased by 20%. Upon entering All Out, Path Maker's cooldown is refreshed.

facts.claim: During All Out, it gains stronger damage reduction, a faster dash and bonus true damage, but loses its knockback and stun; entering All Out refreshes its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: The charge resists interruption and changes from control to damage during All Out.

cards.answer: Footwork dashes and shields K'Sante. Dashing to an ally has increased range and can cross terrain; an allied champion also receives a shield. During All Out, the dash is faster and its cooldown is shorter.
cards.counterplay: Account for nearby allies extending his reach, and delay burst while his shield is active.

citations.quote: Active: K'Sante dashes, granting himself a shield.
Footwork can also be cast on allies with increased range and speed, and the ability to dash through terrain. If the target ally is a champion, they receive the shield as well.

facts.claim: Dashing to an ally has increased range and can cross terrain; an allied champion also receives a shield.

citations.quote: All Out Bonus: Footwork's dash speed is increased, and its cooldown is reduced by 50%.

facts.claim: During All Out, the dash is faster and its cooldown is shorter.

cards.priority_reason: His shield and ally dash affect both trading and engagement range.

cards.answer: All Out displaces an enemy champion and brings K'Sante behind them; pushing the target through terrain adds damage and control. He then gains stronger attacks, healing and empowered basic abilities while sacrificing defenses.
cards.counterplay: Avoid terrain behind you near K'Sante, and regroup if he separates you from your team.

citations.quote: Active: K'Sante roots an enemy and then shatters his tonfas, knocking them back, blinking behind them, and dealing physical damage. If the enemy is pushed into terrain, they will be knocked over it and take additional physical damage. The target is stunned at the end of the push, and also knocked up again if they were pushed through terrain.

facts.claim: All Out displaces an enemy champion and brings K'Sante behind them; pushing the target through terrain adds damage and control.

citations.quote: Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
During this time, his basic abilities are empowered and have no mana cost.

facts.claim: He then gains stronger attacks, healing and empowered basic abilities while sacrificing defenses.

cards.priority_reason: His ultimate can isolate a target across terrain and changes his fighting pattern.

conflicts.resolution: Describe the defensive sacrifice qualitatively; omit a maximum-health reduction claim because the detailed mechanics specify a health threshold while retaining maximum health.

cooldown_candidates.reason: Defensive charge and control window; entering All Out refreshes it.
Repeatable control whose cooldown becomes shorter during All Out.
Mobility and shielding window whose cooldown becomes shorter during All Out.

factual_risks: Wiki E describes additional All Out terrain crossing and location range in its summary without detailing them in the main All Out paragraph; the card limits terrain crossing to the explicitly supported ally dash.
